core_obligations: Set up the computation (proof lines 11437-11448): the author describes the stalk of j_!F at a geometric point as the filtered colimit of the sections of j_!F over etale neighbourhoods of the point, and unwinds the description of those sections.

Identify the direct sum (proof lines 11448-11460): the sections over a neighbourhood are sums of sections of F over the points of the fibre, so the stalk is the direct sum of the stalks of F over the geometric points of U mapping to the given point of X.
Exactness (proof lines 11460-11465): since the stalk of j_!F is computed by an expression exact in F and the family of points of the fibre, j_! is exact.
proof_roadmap: Write the stalk as a filtered colimit of sections of extension by zero.
Unwind the description of those sections as sums over the fibre.
Read off the direct sum formula and the exactness of j_!.
difficulty_reason: The proposition computes the stalks of extension by zero along an etale morphism as the direct sum of the stalks of the given sheaf over the geometric points of the fibre, and deduces exactness of the functor (statement lines 11424-11435). The proof describes the stalk as a filtered colimit of sections of extension by zero (proof lines 11437-11448), unwinds the description of those sections as sums over the points of the fibre to obtain the direct sum formula (proof lines 11448-11460), and reads off exactness (proof lines 11460-11465). The non-formal content is the identification of the filtered colimit with the direct sum over the fibre. The claim is H2: one computation plus one consequence.
